migration_note: This reviewed schema includes canonical execution and participant tables, the bounded physical-execution skills.execution_profile_json profile field, the dispatch completion_reported participant lifecycle required for owner-confirmed outcomes, and compatibility migrations for legacy Memory Profile verification timestamps. Existing databases receive additive phone_verified_at and email_verified_at columns plus the participant lifecycle constraint migration without fabricating verification evidence or creating a delivery-specific lifecycle.
migration_policy: Future schema changes require a reviewed migration/update and an explicit manifest refresh; runtime CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS remains the legacy bootstrap baseline until the persistence adapter is cut over.
